author: Claude taslak (H-071); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geçmiş zamanda (past simple); Türkçede doğal anlatım için çoğunlukla -di / -iyordu kullanıldı.
Kelime anlamları cümledeki kullanıma göre verildi; düzensiz geçmiş zaman fiillerinde yalın hâli parantez içinde (fall → fell).
Karşılaştırma (heavier, warmer than, the same as, the biggest) kitabın dil odağıdır; öbeklerde ayrıca çevrildi.

lines.en: Moon Girl
Nia was born on the Moon, and she wanted to see rain.
lines.tr: Nia Ay'da doğmuştu ve yağmur görmek istiyordu.

lines.en: It was the year 2091.
Nia was thirteen.
She lived in Lunaria, a small town under a glass roof.
lines.tr: Cam bir çatının altındaki küçük bir kasabada, Lunaria'da yaşıyordu.

lines.en: Her mum and dad were scientists there.
lines.tr: Annesi ve babası orada bilim insanıydı.

lines.en: On the Moon, the sky was always black.
The weather was always the same.
Every day was clean, quiet and dry.
lines.tr: Her gün temiz, sessiz ve kuruydu.

lines.en: From her bedroom window, Nia could see the Earth.
lines.tr: Nia yatak odasının penceresinden Dünya'yı görebiliyordu.

lines.en: It was blue and white, and very far away.
lines.tr: Dünya mavi ve beyazdı, çok da uzaktı.

lines.en: "What is rain really like?" she often asked.
lines.tr: "Yağmur gerçekten nasıl bir şey?" diye sık sık sorardı.

lines.en: Her parents remembered rain, but they never agreed.
lines.tr: Annesiyle babası yağmuru hatırlıyordu ama hiç anlaşamıyorlardı.

lines.en: Mum said it was cold.
Dad said it was warm.
Nia wanted to know for herself.
Nia had a friend on Earth.
His name was Leo, and he was thirteen too.
lines.tr: Adı Leo'ydu, o da on üç yaşındaydı.

words.name: ad, isim
words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: They wrote to each other every week.
Leo and his grandma had a farm in a hot, dry valley.
lines.tr: Leo'yla büyükannesinin sıcak, kuru bir vadide bir çiftliği vardı.

lines.en: His letters were full of things Nia never saw.
lines.tr: Mektupları Nia'nın hiç görmediği şeylerle doluydu.

lines.en: Dogs.
Wind.
Trees taller than houses.
Her favourite letter was about rain.
"Rain is not only water," Leo wrote.
lines.tr: Leo şöyle yazmıştı: "Yağmur yalnızca su değildir."

lines.en: "It has a smell.
Grandma says the earth smells sweet after rain.
lines.tr: Büyükannem yağmurdan sonra toprağın tatlı koktuğunu söyler.

lines.en: You can't smell it anywhere else."
lines.tr: Bu kokuyu başka hiçbir yerde alamazsın."

lines.en: Nia read that letter ten times.
lines.tr: Nia o mektubu on kez okudu.

lines.en: A smell!
"I'm going to smell it one day," she wrote back.
lines.tr: "Bir gün o kokuyu alacağım," diye cevap yazdı.

lines.en: "I promise."
But going to Earth was not easy.
The Earth was much bigger than the Moon.
Everything there was six times heavier.
lines.tr: Orada her şey altı kat daha ağırdı.

lines.en: "Your legs are going to feel like stone," said Dr Ansel.
lines.tr: Doktor Ansel, "Bacakların taş gibi gelecek," dedi.

lines.en: So every morning, Nia trained in the sports room.
lines.tr: Bu yüzden Nia her sabah spor odasında çalıştı.

lines.en: She walked in heavy shoes.
She ran on a machine that made her body heavier.
lines.tr: Vücudunu daha ağır yapan bir makinede koştu.

lines.en: It was hard.
Some days she wanted to stop.
Then she remembered Leo's letter.
The sweet smell of the earth after rain.
And she put on the heavy shoes again.
One evening, Mum came home with a big smile.
lines.tr: Bir akşam annesi kocaman bir gülümsemeyle eve geldi.

lines.en: "Nia, sit down," she said.
"I have news."
Mum put a small blue card on the table.
lines.tr: Annesi masaya küçük mavi bir kart koydu.

lines.en: "Is that…?" asked Nia.
"Yes.
It's your ticket to Earth.
We're going to visit Leo's family for two weeks."
lines.tr: İki haftalığına Leo'nun ailesini ziyaret edeceğiz."

lines.en: Nia jumped up so high that her head touched the roof.
lines.tr: Nia öyle yükseğe zıpladı ki başı çatıya değdi.

lines.en: On the Moon, that was easy.
She wrote to Leo that night.
"I'm coming!
Is it going to rain?"
Leo's answer came three days later.
lines.tr: Leo'nun cevabı üç gün sonra geldi.

lines.en: It was very short.
"Come," he wrote.
"But there is no rain here.
The last rain was forty days ago."
Too Much Sky

words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: The spaceship landed on a hot afternoon.
lines.tr: Uzay gemisi sıcak bir öğleden sonra indi.

lines.en: Nia stood up, and her legs felt like stone.
lines.tr: Nia ayağa kalktı ve bacakları taş gibi geldi.

lines.en: Dr Ansel was right.
Her small bag felt heavier than a big suitcase.
lines.tr: Küçük çantası büyük bir bavuldan daha ağır geliyordu.

lines.en: Then the door opened, and she saw the sky.
lines.tr: Sonra kapı açıldı ve Nia gökyüzünü gördü.

lines.en: It was not black.
It was blue, and it was everywhere.
It had no roof and no end.
lines.tr: Ne çatısı vardı ne de sonu.

lines.en: Nia stopped at the door.
Her heart was fast.
She held Dad's hand hard.
"It's too big," she said quietly.

words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: "Where does it stop?"
"It doesn't," said Dad.
"That's the best part."
Nia didn't think so.
She looked at the ground all the way to the car.
Leo was taller than in his photos, and he laughed a lot.
lines.tr: Leo fotoğraflarındakinden daha uzundu ve çok gülüyordu.

lines.en: His grandma, Edda, gave Nia a long, warm hug.
lines.tr: Büyükannesi Edda, Nia'ya uzun ve sıcak bir sarılış verdi.

lines.en: She smelled of bread.
The farm was beautiful, but it was very dry.
The fields were yellow and brown.
The ground had long lines in it, like an old face.
lines.tr: Toprakta yaşlı bir yüz gibi uzun çizgiler vardı.

lines.en: "Forty days," said Grandma Edda.
She looked up at the empty sky.
"Forty days and not one drop."
Nia looked up too, but only for a second.
lines.tr: Nia da yukarı baktı ama yalnızca bir saniyeliğine.

words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: The sky was still too big for her.
lines.tr: Gökyüzü hâlâ ona göre çok büyüktü.

words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: The next morning, Leo showed Nia the farm.
lines.tr: Ertesi sabah Leo, Nia'ya çiftliği gösterdi.

lines.en: There were long black pipes on the ground.
They went between the plants like snakes.
Every few metres, there was a small metal head on top.
lines.tr: Birkaç metrede bir, üstlerinde küçük metal bir başlık vardı.

lines.en: One of them went right past the house, under Nia's window.
lines.tr: Biri tam evin yanından, Nia'nın penceresinin altından geçiyordu.

lines.en: "What are those?" asked Nia.
"Our water pipes," said Leo happily.
lines.tr: Leo mutlu bir sesle, "Su borularımız," dedi.

lines.en: "I built them with Grandma.
At night, they throw water over the fields."
Leo turned a red wheel near the house.
lines.tr: Leo evin yanındaki kırmızı bir çarkı çevirdi.

lines.en: Water jumped out of the little heads.
It flew up and fell on the tomatoes.
lines.tr: Su havaya yükseldi ve domateslerin üstüne düştü.

lines.en: Nia put her hand in it.
The water was warm, like bath water.
"It's like rain!" she said.
"Almost," said Leo.
"But real rain is better."
He turned the wheel off.
"We have to save water.
We only use them at night."
That evening, they watched the weather report on Grandma's old computer.
lines.tr: O akşam büyükannenin eski bilgisayarında hava durumuna baktılar.

lines.en: There was a map with a big grey cloud on it.
lines.tr: Haritada büyük, gri bir bulut vardı.

lines.en: "Rain is coming on Friday," said the weather report.
lines.tr: Hava durumu, "Cuma günü yağmur geliyor," dedi.

lines.en: Leo shouted.
Grandma Edda laughed.
"Friday is in three days," said Leo.
"Perfect, Moon Girl!"
That night, Nia sat at her window.
lines.tr: O gece Nia penceresinin önünde oturdu.

lines.en: Outside, the sky was full of stars.
She looked up for one minute.
Then for two minutes.
"Three more days," she said to the stars.
Friday
On Wednesday, Nia looked at the sky for ten minutes.
lines.tr: Çarşamba günü Nia gökyüzüne on dakika baktı.

lines.en: On Thursday, she looked for half an hour.
It was getting easier.
Leo taught her about clouds.
"The small white ones are nice," he said.
"But they never bring rain.
You need big grey ones.
Dark and heavy, like old blankets."
lines.tr: Koyu ve ağır, eski battaniyeler gibi."

lines.en: On Friday morning, the sky was white and flat.
lines.tr: Cuma sabahı gökyüzü beyaz ve dümdüzdü.

lines.en: Nia ran outside early.
Then the clouds came.
They got darker and bigger.
Soon they were the biggest clouds Nia ever saw.
lines.tr: Çok geçmeden Nia'nın şimdiye kadar gördüğü en büyük bulutlar oldular.

lines.en: The wind was cooler now.
The trees moved.
"Here it comes," said Grandma Edda.
Everyone waited.
Grandma put buckets in the garden.
Leo and Nia stood in the dry field.
lines.tr: Leo ile Nia kuru tarlada durdu.

lines.en: Nia turned her face up to the sky.
They waited for ten minutes.
Then an hour.
Then all afternoon.
Nothing fell.
Not one drop.
In the evening, the wind changed.
Slowly, the grey clouds moved away to the east.
lines.tr: Gri bulutlar yavaş yavaş doğuya doğru uzaklaştı.

lines.en: Behind them, the sky was clear and hot again.
lines.tr: Arkalarında gökyüzü yine açık ve sıcaktı.

lines.en: "It happens," said Grandma Edda softly.
lines.tr: Edda Nine yumuşak bir sesle, "Olur böyle," dedi.

lines.en: "The clouds were only passing."
Nia went inside without a word.
lines.tr: Nia tek kelime etmeden içeri girdi.

lines.en: In her room, Nia sat on the bed.
She opened her notebook and wrote.
Only five days are left.
Then we are going to fly home.
A tear fell on the page.
Then another one.
Someone knocked on the door.
It was Leo.
"Are you OK?" he asked.
"I'm fine," said Nia.
But her voice was not fine.
lines.tr: Ama sesi hiç de iyi değildi.

lines.en: Leo looked at her for a long time.
Then he closed the door quietly.
A minute later, Nia heard the back door.
lines.tr: Bir dakika sonra Nia arka kapının sesini duydu.

lines.en: Then she heard nothing.
Late at night, Nia woke up.
There was a sound on the roof.
Tap.
Tap, tap.
She sat up in bed.
The sound got faster.
Tap-tap-tap-tap.
It was soft, and it was everywhere.
Nia's heart jumped.
She knew this sound from old films.
She ran to the window.
It was dark outside, but the glass was wet.
Nia ran down the stairs in her pyjamas.
She opened the back door.
Everything was wet.
The Smell of Rain
Water fell on Nia's hair, her face and her arms.
lines.tr: Su Nia'nın saçlarına, yüzüne ve kollarına yağdı.

lines.en: She laughed and turned around and around.
lines.tr: Güldü ve kendi etrafında dönüp durdu.

lines.en: "Rain!" she shouted.
"It's raining!"
It was warmer than she expected.
It was softer, too.

words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: Then Leo walked out of the dark.
He was wet, and his shoes were very dirty.
"Is this it?" asked Nia.
"Is this real rain?"
"Yes," said Leo.
But he didn't look at her.
Nia closed her eyes.
She breathed in slowly and deeply.
lines.tr: Yavaş ve derin bir nefes aldı.

lines.en: She waited for the smell.
The sweet smell of the earth from his letter.
But there was nothing.
The air smelled of water and a little of metal.
lines.tr: Hava su ve biraz da metal kokuyordu.

lines.en: It smelled the same as the water in Lunaria.
Nia opened her eyes and looked up.
Above the house, she saw stars.
Lots of stars, and only one small cloud.
lines.tr: Bir sürü yıldız ve yalnızca küçük bir bulut.

lines.en: And the water did not come from above.
It came from the side, from somewhere near her window.
lines.tr: Yandan, penceresinin yakınında bir yerden geliyordu.

lines.en: Then the water stopped.
Everything was quiet.
Leo didn't move.
They sat on the wet steps for almost an hour.
lines.tr: Islak basamaklarda neredeyse bir saat oturdular.

lines.en: Far away, there was a low sound, like a big drum.
lines.tr: Uzaklardan büyük bir davul gibi alçak bir ses geldi.

lines.en: The wind changed.
It was colder now, much colder.
lines.tr: Hava artık daha soğuktu, çok daha soğuk.

lines.en: The small cloud was not alone anymore.
A dark wall of clouds came over the hill.
lines.tr: Tepenin üstünden koyu bir bulut duvarı geldi.

lines.en: The first drop hit Nia on the nose.
It was cold!
Then another, and another.
lines.tr: Sonra bir tane daha, bir tane daha.

lines.en: Then the whole sky opened.
This water was different.
It was heavier and colder, and it came from high above.
lines.tr: Daha ağır ve daha soğuktu, yukarılardan geliyordu.

lines.en: Then the smell came.
It came up from the dry ground, sweet and deep.
lines.tr: Kuru topraktan yükseldi, tatlı ve derin.

lines.en: It smelled like bread, old wood and something new.
lines.tr: Ekmek, eski tahta ve yeni bir şey gibi kokuyordu.

lines.en: Nobody needed to tell Nia.
She knew.
"This is rain," she said softly.
"This is the real rain."
Leo stood next to her.
He turned his face up to the sky too.

words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: "I'm sorry," he said.
"The first rain was me.
I turned on the pipes.
The one under your window."
"I know," said Nia.
"Your rain was warmer.
And it had no smell."
"You were so sad.
I only wanted…"
"I know," she said again, and she smiled.
"It was the kindest rain in the world."

chunks.en: the kindest rain in the world

lines.en: They laughed and stayed outside until they were very, very wet.
lines.tr: Gülüştüler ve sırılsıklam olana kadar dışarıda kaldılar.

chunks.en: until they were very, very wet

lines.en: Grandma Edda came out with an umbrella.
lines.tr: Edda Nine elinde bir şemsiyeyle dışarı çıktı.

lines.en: Then she closed it and stood with them.
lines.tr: Sonra şemsiyeyi kapattı ve onların yanında durdu.

lines.en: That night, Nia wrote in her notebook.
Rain is colder than you think.
It is heavier, too.

words.too: de, da; çok (too big: fazla büyük)

lines.en: And it smells better than anything on the Moon.
lines.tr: Ve Ay'daki her şeyden daha güzel kokar.

phrases.note: Nia was born on the Moon. = Nia Ay'da doğdu. Türkçede etken fiil, İngilizcede was/were born kalıbı.
Kısa sıfat + -er + than; y ile biten sıfatta y → i: heavy → heavier.
It smelled the same as the water in Lunaria.
Karşılaştırmayı güçlendirmek için much: much bigger, much colder.
We're going to visit Leo's family. Plan ya da kesin gibi görünen gelecek.
Üstünlük: the + -est. big → biggest (son harf ikilenir).
